text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, after having won many races, Narita Taishin drops by.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: So, about that hot spring ticket…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Both Ticket and Hayahide are busy, and I've got no one else to go with me, so…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Uh… If you've got nothing better to do…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's finally here—it's time to use the vacation ticket we won at the raffle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But first… I have to get through the mountains of paperwork that's piled up over the course of the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I roll up my sleeves and bury myself in work for the next few days.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: And that's everything! Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Um, you appear to be rather exhausted. Make sure to rest up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I manage to finish up all of my work, and the next day quickly rolls around.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Okay. The schedule's fine with me, but…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Are you sure you're okay to go on vacation looking like that? I feel like a light breeze could knock you over.
choice_data_list: I can wash my exhaustion away in the hot spring!
I can wash my exhaustion away in the hot spring!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Meh. It's your funeral.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so we set off.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Who chooses such a decked out place for the prize of some shopping raffle?
choice_data_list: I bet the hot spring will be amazing!
I bet the hot spring will be amazing!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I feel much better after my bath. It seems the long soak really did take away my exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My head feels a little light, but I'm sure the dizziness will fade soon enough.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Phew.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh, did you just finish up too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sure, it wasn't half bad.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wait, your face is really red. Were you in the hot water for too long?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey, are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Snap out of it! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Finally, you're awake. Do you remember getting lightheaded and passing out?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Do you even know what you're apologizing for?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: If it's for ruining our trip or for collapsing and being a pain…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Then I'll kick you right back into the hot spring. Boil for all I care.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I talked with Tazuna earlier, and she said you were working like mad so you could go on this trip.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What am I supposed to do with you if you pass out from exhaustion? Bonehead.
choice_data_list: I thought this would be a good reward for all your wins…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Seriously, I think you might hold the record for being the biggest dummy in the world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin abruptly stretches her hand towards me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Poke! Jab!
choice_data_list: Ow, ow, ow! What are you doing?!
Ow, ow, ow! What are you doing?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: The staff taught me a pressure point to get rid of dizziness from heat exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Now stay there, and don't move!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her jabs are too much, and I shuffle away from the painful prodding. I manage to escape her for a moment, but…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Stop trying to get away.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Those teary eyes won't stop me. I'm not here to be nice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Save. Your. Breath!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I hope you learned your lesson now. Don't push yourself for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You're the only person who's crazy enough to put up with me and be my trainer, so…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I don't know what I'd do without you.
choice_data_list: I'm sure there are plenty of people lining up to be your trainer now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh! That's not what I meant!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Get it through your thick head—you're the only trainer for me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You'd better get what I'm saying now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense that Narita Taishin and I have formed an irreplaceable bond during our trip.
